note: From Krishna 1963 (American Museum Novitates 2161), a revision of the African genus Foraminitermes. The original reads Imago: Unknown; only the soldier is described and measured (Table 3, two columns, homoeotype / syntype). Closely related to F. valens, from which it differs in the larger head and the more prominent frontal projection. Type locality Mukimbungu, Congo.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow (darker in the syntype), postclypeal region reddish brown; anteclypeus pale yellow; labrum pale yellow with a white tip; mandibles reddish brown, pale yellow at the base; antennae pale yellow; pronotum pale yellow; legs creamy white. Head with a few short setae and hairs; pronotum sparsely covered with a few setae; longitudinal ridge of the fore coxa with minute hairs; abdominal tergites and sternites densely covered with stiff setae. Head small; frontal projection distinct, tubular in lateral view, blunt, slightly upturned; frons inclined about 60° towards the anteclypeus. Mandibles short, outer margin nearly straight; left mandible with 3 or 4 obtuse-rounded teeth. Postmental constriction index 0.51—0.56. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum deeply concave in the middle; sides straight, receding posteriorly; posterior margin straight or slightly concave. Measurements (homoeotype / syntype, mm): head length (to the lateral mandible base) 1.46/1.50; head width 0.99/0.98; head height 0.98/0.98; left mandible length 0.60/0.60; postmentum greatest width 0.32/0.35, least width 0.18/0.18, length 1.03/1.05; pronotum greatest length 0.32/0.34, width 0.60/0.58; hind tibia length 0.75/0.75.
